title: Your first nodes
description: Place a Group, label it, put a Text inside, and give it words.

steps.body:
## Welcome
In this lesson you'll build your first tiny piece of an app out of **nodes**. Click **Next** to begin.

steps.title: Open the App component
steps.body: In the **Components** panel, open the component called **App**.

steps.title: Add a Group
steps.body: Double-click the canvas and add a **Group** node. A Group is a visual container.

steps.title: Label the Group "Card"
steps.body: Select the Group and set its **label** to `Card` in the properties panel.

steps.title: Put a Text inside Card
steps.body: Add a **Text** node as a child of your `Card` group.

steps.title: Give the Text some words
steps.body: Set the Text node's **Text** parameter to `Hello`.
🎉 You built a labelled container with text inside it — all as nodes you can see and connect. Click **Exit lesson** to finish.
